leads.title: Gender Expression Non-Discrimination Act (GENDA)
leads.documents: Statewide law explicitly extending discrimination protections in credit, housing, employment, education, public accommodation to gender identity or expression.
leads.detail: Introduced 2003, passed Assembly annually 2008-2019; passed Senate 2019, signed by Gov. Cuomo January 2019, effective February 2019

leads.title: Gov. David Paterson Executive Order (2009) and Gov. Andrew Cuomo DHR Directive/Regulations (2015-2016)
leads.documents: Executive and administrative machinery banning gender-identity discrimination in state employment and by Division of Human Rights in employment, housing, education, credit, public accommodations.
leads.detail: Paterson order Dec 16, 2009; Cuomo announcement Oct 22, 2015 directing NY State Division of Human Rights (DHR) to promulgate regulations; issued Nov 4, 2015, effective Jan 20, 2016

leads.title: Hate Crimes Act of 2000, as amended
leads.documents: Hate-crime coverage for anti-LGBTQ violence and enforcement upgrade.
leads.detail: Covered sexual orientation since July 1, 2001, gender identity and expression since Nov 1, 2019; Nov 2022 Gov. Kathy Hochul signed pair of anti-bias bills described as toughest hate crime legislation

leads.title: Gender Recognition Act and NYC X-marker ordinances / birth certificate policy
leads.documents: Legal gender-change machinery: no surgery requirement, self-affirmation, X marker on birth certificates, driver's licenses, death certificates, court/jury and health data, sealing name-change records.
leads.detail: Since 2014 affidavit allowed change; NYC Council 41-6 Sept 2018 for X on birth certificates, signed Oct 10, 2018 by Mayor de Blasio effective Jan 1, 2019; X on death certificates from Jan 2, 2020; AG Letitia James 2020 self-affirmation policy age 17+; Gender Recognition Act passed June 2021

leads.title: New York State Shield / Safe Haven Law and NYC Executive Order (2023)
leads.documents: Protects access to gender-affirming care, bars out-of-state enforcement, custody seizure, and police cooperation for care legally provided in NY.
leads.detail: NYC Mayor Eric Adams executive order June 12, 2023 preventing use of city resources to detain/prosecute/investigate gender-affirming care; Gov. Hochul bill signed June 25, 2023; described as 12th state shield law; Ithaca ordinance Sept 2023; NYC Council bills April 2025

leads.title: Repeal of Penal Law Section 240.37 - 'walking while trans' law
leads.documents: Repeal of 1976 anti-loitering/prostitution law documented as used by police to harass and arrest transgender individuals.
leads.detail: Implemented 1976; repeal passed NY Senate 45-16 and Assembly 105-44 Feb 2021, signed by Gov. Cuomo effective immediately

leads.title: Conversion Therapy Ban - Bill A576 (2019) and prior Cuomo regulations (2016)
leads.documents: Statewide ban on conversion therapy on minors by health providers and insurer coverage ban.
leads.detail: Regulations announced Feb 6, 2016 effective April 27; Bill A576 passed Assembly 141-7 and Senate 57-4 Jan 15, 2019, signed by Gov. Cuomo effective Jan 25, 2019

leads.title: Repeal of gay and transgender panic defense (2019)
leads.documents: Abolition of common-law gay/trans panic defense in criminal cases.
leads.detail: Passed NY State Legislature June 2019, signed by Gov. Cuomo effective immediately; 6th US state to abolish

leads.title: Gender-neutral bathrooms law (2020-2021)
leads.documents: Requirement for gender-neutral/single-occupancy bathroom access statewide relevant to public-accommodation safety.
leads.detail: Passed NY State Legislature Nov 2020, signed by Gov. Cuomo Dec 2020, effective March 23, 2021 (90 days after signature)

leads.title: 2024 Amendment to Constitution of New York
leads.documents: Constitutional ban on discrimination on basis of gender identity and sexual orientation.
leads.detail: Amended 2024 following successful ballot measure to explicitly ban discrimination on gender identity and sexual orientation
